definition: Having a bad name because people do not consider someone respectable.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: “However, I must not sit gossiping here, but must get these disreputable clothes off and return to my highly respectable self.”
example_sentence: The band rehearsed in a disreputable pub behind the station.
